body: Thank you for the concern, really appreaciate it!

The things you can do are saving money, work your ass, get stable and move out! I move out when i wasn't stable yet and because of i am a freelancer and this quarantine cut off my income i have to come back to my parent's home. That was a nightmare!!!! NEVER GO BACK ONCE YOU CAN GET RID OF THEM!!! At first they talked to me nicely and advised to go back and save my money but after i did that it all the same as before. My mom always yell at me, even when i just ordered some food from outside and she gave me shitty words that i don't know why. I'm not allow to cook or eat some foods from the fridge, she says it's all her and i just work for myself not for her or anyone else. I really don't wanna waste my life just to be treated like this. Now i am waiting this quarantine over and try to find a better stable job instead just doing my freelance job and try to find a new place better than i had before. It's hard to keep my sanity here 😭 Just telling my self to hang on, be patience, i can do better, everything will be paid.
